Dear Madam
I am afraid these papers will not quite suit the [Packet](/periodical/52).
Would not [Friendly Leaves](/periodical/71) be a good field for them[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Friendly Leaves (1876-1917) was the magazine of the Girls’ Friendly Society, and continued as The Girls’ Friendly Society Magazine to 1951.
